evolution.rule: c if c > 0.5 else (1 if sum_n >= 1 and random() < 0.4 else 0)

color.red: 1 if v < 0.25 else (0 if v < 0.5 else (1 if v < 0.75 else 0.2))
color.green: 0.5 if v < 0.25 else (1 if v < 0.5 else (0.5 if v < 0.75 else 0))
color.blue: 0 if v < 0.25 else (0.5 if v < 0.5 else (1 if v < 0.75 else 1))
